_doc: Data rows for element_pset_native (prompts/DISC_WALK_DRAWN_INTEGRATION.md 12b). unit_map: an UNTYPED number of an authoring tool's own property set gets value_si = value * factor ONLY through a row here; no row = unit unknown. pset and name are LIKE patterns (% = any run). Every row states its measured evidence. Nothing here is a guess: add a row only with a measurement.

unit_map.name: %Voltage%
unit_map.source: measured 2026-11-10 Ifc2x3_Duplex_MEP.ifc: Switch Voltage 1291.669250 = 120 V, Voltage 2238.893 = 208 V; factor = (0.3048 m/ft)^2, Revit internal units (V = kg.m2/(s3.A), length in feet)

unit_map.name: % Connected
unit_map.source: measured 2026-11-10 Ifc2x3_Duplex_MEP.ifc: HVAC Connected 5166.677 = 480 VA, Lighting - Dwelling Unit Connected = 900 VA, Receptacle Connected = 4140 / 4320 VA (round values only under this factor)

unit_map.name: % Estimated Demand
unit_map.source: measured 2026-11-10 Ifc2x3_Duplex_MEP.ifc: equal to the Connected value at demand factor 1.0 on every panel

unit_map.name: Apparent Load%
unit_map.source: measured 2026-11-10 Ifc2x3_Duplex_MEP.ifc: type Apparent Load = 100 / 150 / 480 / 542 / 146000 VA; panel phase A 51977.333 VA = Current Phase A 433.144 A x 120 V

unit_map.name: Load
unit_map.source: measured 2026-11-10 Ifc2x3_Duplex_MEP.ifc: Load 1937.50 = 180 VA, the value its own label states (Electrical Data ' 120 V/1-180 VA')
